company.name: Boostbar
company.distributes: Branded sweet and salty snacks, Kambly biscuits, Dar-Vida, protein bars, vegan cookies, cake, plus drinks, frozen meals and coffee in connected vending machines and unstaffed kiosks and markets
company.channels_supplied: Workplace vending points for over 300 business customers such as Swisscom, Geberit, Siemens and Stadtspital Triemli Zurich, across Switzerland
company.sf_brands_carried: About a third of the range has a healthy plus (protein-rich, reduced-calorie or organic); Freely Handustry plant-based snacks; no direct sugar-free competitor named
what_they_do_well: Grew to around 1,000 Boostbar points of sale since its founding in 2020, with customers such as Swisscom and Geberit.
Reports food waste below 2% thanks to fully digital machines that optimise refilling.
company.fit_rationale: Zurich-based operator running around 1,000 connected vending points whose Kiosk concept sells sweet and salty snacks, biscuits, protein bars and vegan cookies from other brands. It buys a deliberately healthier range for workplaces, which suits Diablo's sugar-free chocolate, bars and biscuits. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website; it runs its own delivery routes and 60+ technicians across Switzerland.

company.name: Eiweiss GmbH (eiweiss der kraftladen)
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Protein bars and energy bars from Weider, All Stars, Sponser, Multipower and Go Fitness, alongside sports nutrition
company.channels_supplied: Its own sports nutrition shop in the Puls 5 building, Zurich West
what_they_do_well: Runs a dedicated strength and sports nutrition shop in the Puls 5 building in Zurich West.
company.fit_rationale: A Zurich sports nutrition shop in Zurich West that stocks protein and energy bars from several other brands. It is a single shop, so its reach is small; no online shop is shown on its website.

company.name: FELFEL
company.distributes: Branded packaged snacks and chocolate snacks (Kinder), crisps (Zweifel) and drinks through its USEGO office snack service, plus fresh meals, fruit boxes and coffee
company.channels_supplied: Offices and workplaces across Switzerland and Liechtenstein through smart fridges and its USEGO snack and drinks service
what_they_do_well: Swiss family-run workplace catering business founded in Zurich in 2013, serving Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
company.fit_rationale: FELFEL was founded in Zurich and its USEGO service restocks offices weekly with popular snacks and drinks from top brands such as Kinder and Zweifel, sold to employees as they are. Diablo's chocolate, bars and biscuits would suit its health-led workplace offer. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Food Agentur GmbH
company.based_out_of: Switzerland (town not stated on its website)
company.distributes: Edible promotional gifts: branded sweets and gummies (Haribo Goldbären and Primavera, Skittles, Tic Tac), chocolate (Toblerone, Lindt), Dextro Energy glucose sweets, chewing gum and snacks, supplied with the customer's logo
company.channels_supplied: Companies, SMEs, start-ups and event organisers buying giveaways and corporate gifts; references include SBB, Sunrise, Holcim and Raiffeisen
company.sf_brands_carried: Sugar-free gummy bears offered, brand not named on its website
what_they_do_well: Over 27 years in promotional products, with corporate references including SBB, Sunrise, Holcim, Raiffeisen and Hublot.
company.fit_rationale: A Swiss promotional specialist whose whole range is food, reselling other brands' packaged sweets and chocolate such as Haribo, Toblerone, Lindt and Dextro Energy as logo giveaways, so Diablo's sugar-free sweets and chocolate suit its health-minded corporate gift buyers. Tier 3 because it sells to companies buying giveaways, not to shops. Storage: sells at fixed CHF prices through its own web shop, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Geschenkkoerbe.ch (kommerce GmbH)
company.distributes: Gift baskets and gift boxes with chocolate, wafers, biscuits, sweets and chips from other brands (Straumann Hueppen, Jakob's Basler Leckerly, La Perla di Torino, Choba Choba, Gottlieber, Patatas Nana), plus advent calendars
company.channels_supplied: Own online shop to consumers and companies; corporate gifts for employees and business partners with logo personalisation
what_they_do_well: Says over 3,000 Swiss companies use its business gift baskets.
Member of HANDELSVERBAND.swiss with next working day delivery on orders by 18:00.
company.fit_rationale: A national gift basket retailer whose shop has its own Schokolade und Suesses, Snacks und Chips and Suessgebaeck und Kekse categories stocked with other companies' brands, sold to over 3,000 Swiss companies. Diablo's chocolate, biscuits and gift boxes fit its employee and partner baskets. Storage: sells from its own stock with next working day delivery, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Gingi (Handelssociete Aksu & Winkler)
company.distributes: Vegan food and non-food online shop with a Lebensmittel section including chocolate, muesli and cheese alternatives, plus vegan proteins and supplements from brands such as Sunwarrior, PROFUEL and Vitabay
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop, delivering only within Switzerland
company.fit_rationale: A Swiss vegan online shop that resells other brands and has its own chocolate category, so Diablo's vegan muesli bars, wafer, cookie, peanut butters and jams match its shoppers. Tier 3 because it is a small owner-run webshop; its brand list in the chocolate category could not be opened and its order volume is not stated on its website.

company.name: McDrogerie Der Artikel wird zum Warenkorb hinzugefügt
noury AG
company.distributes: Sweet and salty snacks, chocolate and nuts from well-known brands, plus fresh meals, drinks, fruit and coffee
company.channels_supplied: Workplaces, schools and sports centres through noury smart fridges and markets
what_they_do_well: Founded in 2021, it offers modular workplace catering with a showroom in Lotzwil.
company.fit_rationale: noury fills office smart fridges with sweet and salty snacks and chocolate from popular, well-known brands, sold to employees as they are, which suits Diablo's chocolate, bars and biscuits. It says it serves Switzerland from Langenthal; Zurich customers are not named on its website, which places it in tier 3. Storage: sells from its own stock with regular deliveries, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: OH MY BOX KLG
company.distributes: Snack boxes and gift boxes filled with branded chocolate, sweets and biscuits (Lindt, Kinder, Haribo, M&M's, Knoppers, Smarties, Nutella), including a protein snack box
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with delivery across Switzerland, and custom boxes for companies to give to staff and clients
what_they_do_well: Builds custom company gift boxes with logo and greeting card, shipped direct to employees.
company.fit_rationale: It buys other companies' branded sweets, chocolate and biscuits and packs them into snack and gift boxes for shoppers and for companies' staff. Diablo's chocolate, sweets and gift boxes fit its boxes, and a protein box shows a health-minded line. Storage: ships every box from its own warehouse (Lager), named on its About page.

company.name: Organisation Deval Sàrl
company.distributes: Branded chocolate bars and countlines (Mars, Snickers, Twix, Kit Kat, Kinder Bueno, Lion, Cailler, Lindt), sweets, gummies and chewing gum (Haribo, Mentos, Ricola, Fini, Stimorol, Tic Tac), plus drinks and general groceries
company.channels_supplied: Trade customers in Valais and Vaud through a B2B web shop with professional pricing; customer types are not named on its website
company.sf_brands_carried: Werther's sugar-free box and sugar-free chewing gum (Mentos, Stimorol)
what_they_do_well: Runs a B2B web shop with around 550 branded items and trade prices, with free delivery from CHF 250 across Valais and Vaud.
company.fit_rationale: A confectionery-led wholesaler founded by the Revaz brothers whose shop sells other companies' branded chocolate bars and sweets in counter cases priced for single-unit resale, the format kiosks and snack counters use. Diablo's chocolate bars, sweets and gummies would sit beside the Mars, Ferrero and Haribo lines it already sells to Valais and Vaud trade buyers. Storage: sells from its own stock through a B2B web shop with prices, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Rose Betriebsverpflegung AG
company.distributes: Chocolate bars (Snickers, Bounty, Kinder Bueno, Kaegi-Fret, Pick Up), biscuits (Kambly, Spitzbueb), cakes, cookies, cereal and protein bars (Balisto, Barebells), chewing gum (Mentos), crisps and nuts in workplace vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Workplace vending and food machines: over 1,000 refreshment points for about 450 company customers, with sales teams for western and eastern Switzerland
what_they_do_well: Family business with about 35 staff serving over 1,000 refreshment points for around 450 customers.
Calls itself the Swiss market leader in premium workplace catering, active since 2009.
company.fit_rationale: Its filling product order list shows around 150 items in which branded chocolate bars, biscuits, cakes and bars outnumber coffee, all sold as they are to employees. It curates the range per site and already lists better-for-you bars. Storage: sells from its own stock with its own logistics team and route planning, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Schweizer Heimatwerk
company.distributes: Swiss gifts and souvenirs with a food section of chocolate bars and gift chocolate (Lindt, AZ, Toblerone, Taucherli, Garçoa) and Kambly biscuit tins
company.channels_supplied: Own shops at Uraniastrasse and Bahnhofstrasse in Zurich and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Runs two shops in central Zurich, on Bahnhofstrasse and Uraniastrasse, listed by Zurich Tourism.
company.fit_rationale: Zurich gift and souvenir retailer whose online food section spans three pages, mostly branded chocolate and biscuits from other companies. Its two central Zurich shops serve visitors and gift buyers, so Diablo's gift boxes and chocolate fit the shelf; it sells mainly Swiss brands, so a sugar-free gift line would be a clear point of difference.

company.name: Simone Sans Gluten
company.channel: Gluten free and free from shops
company.distributes: 100% gluten free grocery with a sweet section (Moments Doux): biscuits, madeleines, donuts and chocolate snacks from Piaceri Mediterranei (Golomix, Quadrotti), plus savoury, flours and drinks
company.channels_supplied: Own shop in Sierre (Valais) and its online shop
company.sf_brands_carried: Announced an organic and vegan range with low or no sugar for 2026
what_they_do_well: Runs a 100% gluten free shop in Sierre with its own online shop and daily take-away meals.
company.fit_rationale: A family-run gluten free and lactose free shop in Valais that imports selected brands and sells biscuits and chocolate snacks online and in store. Tier 3 because it is a single shop; it plans a low or no sugar range for 2026, which suits Diablo.

company.name: Snack That GmbH
company.distributes: Healthy sweet and savoury snacks, granola bars, drinks and meals in vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Healthy snack vending machines at companies, schools, hospitals and gyms; free of rent from 250 users per site
company.sf_brands_carried: Healthy snacks range; brands not named on its website
company.fit_rationale: A healthy snack vending operator that fills and maintains its own machines with a sweet category and granola bars, aimed at health-conscious staff. Product brands are not named on its website. Storage: fills its machines from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Snack24 GmbH
company.distributes: Chocolate bars (Snickers, Twix, KitKat, Mars, Milka), gummies (Haribo, Skittles), biscuits, wafers and cakes (Oreo, Prinzen, Mikado), protein bars, vegan snacks, crisps and drinks in vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Snack vending machines placed at offices, warehouses and workshops, from small teams to sites with over 100 employees
company.sf_brands_carried: Protein bars and vegan snacks in a healthy alternatives section; brands not named
what_they_do_well: Offers a separate healthy alternatives range of protein bars, rice cakes and vegan snacks for staff.
company.fit_rationale: A snack-led vending operator whose product page shows branded chocolate, gummies, biscuits, wafers and healthy bars, with a range put together for each company. Its healthy alternatives shelf suits Diablo's bars and cookies. Storage: fills its own machines from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Swiss Shop 1291 (Dolmetsch AG)
company.distributes: Souvenirs and gifts including Swiss chocolate bars and chocolate gift items from Confiland, alongside Victorinox knives, watches and souvenirs
company.channels_supplied: Own souvenir shops in Zurich main station (ShopVille) and on Limmatquai, plus Zermatt
what_they_do_well: Part of Dolmetsch AG, trading since 1885 when it began as a knife and scissors business.
company.fit_rationale: Souvenir and gift chain with two high footfall Zurich shops, open daily, that lists chocolate bars and gift items from another company's brand in its assortment. Diablo's gift boxes and chocolate suit its tourist and gift shoppers; the number of chocolate lines is not stated on its website.

company.name: Tout-O-Mat
company.distributes: Snacks and chocolate (Malteser and Ragusa shown) in its cold drink and snack machines and automatic shops, plus hot drinks and fresh products
company.channels_supplied: Vending machines and automatic shops in workplaces, shops and clinics in French speaking Switzerland
what_they_do_well: Independent family company trading since 1973.
Joined the European Vending and Coffee Service Association in August 2023.
company.fit_rationale: A family-run vending operator founded in 1973 that runs snack machines and automatic shops for workplaces and clinics. It is listed at tier 3 because its website shows snack brands only in images and gives no fleet size.

company.name: Vending Service AG
company.distributes: Snacks for its snack machines (a snacks section in its product range), cold drinks and coffee
company.channels_supplied: Workplace snack, drink and coffee machines across Switzerland from 10 branches (Aarau, Basel, Bern, Geneva, Lausanne, Lucerne, Neuchatel, Solothurn, Zug, Zurich)
what_they_do_well: Trading in Switzerland since 1991 with about 160 employees.
Runs 10 branches covering German and French speaking Switzerland.
company.fit_rationale: A national vending operator with about 160 staff whose teams fill, service and clean its snack machines, with snacks as the largest section of its product range. The snack brands it stocks are not named on its website. Storage: sells fill products from its own stock through 10 branches, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: wiant (Impact Schweiz Gruppe GmbH)
company.distributes: Curated corporate gift boxes with chocolate, snacks, nuts, dried fruit and drinks from other brands
company.channels_supplied: Companies buying employee and client gift boxes, shipped to offices or private addresses across Switzerland
what_they_do_well: Says it has sent over 50,000 boxes for more than 150 companies.
Handles selection, packing and delivery end to end for corporate clients.
company.fit_rationale: A corporate gift box company built around better-for-you brainfood snacks and chocolate from Swiss brands and food startups, which matches Diablo's health-conscious positioning. Its permanent suppliers are Swiss brands and it considers other products on request. Storage: assembles and ships the boxes itself, warehouse not named on its website.
